# cycle_image_sources (Data Source)

Lists Cycle image sources in the hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cycle_image_sources" "all" {}

output "direct_source_ids" {
  value = [
    for source in data.cycle_image_sources.all.sources : source.id
    if source.type == "direct"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `sources` (Attributes List) The image sources in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))

<a id="nestedatt--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The description of the image source, if one has been set.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the image source.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slug identifier of the image source.
- `name` (String) The name of the image source.
- `state` (String) The current state of the image source.
- `type` (String) The type of images in this source (`direct`, `stack-build`, or `bucket`).
